_comment: Basic start/stop behavior for examples/start_stop.json. NOTE: in the current wiring, x_stop drives the SR reset input through a continuous NOT (not an edge), so R is True on every scan where x_stop is False. This means the SR latch only holds Q=True while x_stop is actively held True alongside x_start release; releasing x_start while x_stop is False immediately resets the motor. This scenario documents that real (momentary-like) behavior rather than an idealized 'latch that holds after start is released'.
